gaps.legacy: AutoGluon stores a fitted ensemble as a model directory, potentially larger than 512 MiB
gaps.dagml: The Python DAG host adapter captures the directory inside one joblib artifact; general archive loading rejects a model payload above 512 MiB. The protocol double covers training, refit and small-archive replay, but real AutoGluon is not installed in this environment
gaps.proposed_contract: Extend the versioned host archive manifest with individually hashed, size-bounded model-directory members or content-addressed sidecars; validate all paths and digests before allowing the language binding to reconstruct the predictor. Keep graph/CV and selection in DAG-ML.

gaps.legacy: by_source/merge:auto exposes one independent prediction per source during training and archive replay
gaps.dagml: CV by_source now captures a signed TrainingOutcome and portable package with all source outputs and final/test scores; the host archive selects named outputs, aligns source rows by sample ID, and validates per-source spectral axes. No-splitter initial full-refit replay still uses a host archive because PortableRefitPackageV3 requires a prior V2 training package; DAG-ML needs an explicit initial full-refit package contract for portable capture without fictitious CV

gaps.dagml: fixed/automatic gates, lambda and RLI fusion, X/y preprocessing chains, learner training controls, branch feature merges, by-source concat with shared or heterogeneous preprocessing, by-metadata FeatureJoin concat, unsplit OOF and nested choices replay; legacy-successful prediction merges before ResidualModel still refuse
